verses.ar: يَا ٱبْنِي، ٱحْفَظْ كَلَامِي وَٱذْخَرْ وَصَايَايَ عِنْدَكَ.
verses.kjv: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
verses.web: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

verses.ar: ٱحْفَظْ وَصَايَايَ فَتَحْيَا، وَشَرِيعَتِي كَحَدَقَةِ عَيْنِكَ.
verses.kjv: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
verses.web: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

verses.ar: اُرْبُطْهَا عَلَى أَصَابِعِكَ. ٱكْتُبْهَا عَلَى لَوْحِ قَلْبِكَ.
verses.kjv: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
verses.web: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

verses.ar: قُلْ لِلْحِكْمَةِ: «أَنْتِ أُخْتِي» وَٱدْعُ ٱلْفَهْمَ ذَا قَرَابَةٍ.
verses.kjv: Say unto wisdom, Thou [art] my sister; and call understanding [thy] kinswoman:
verses.web: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

verses.ar: لِتَحْفَظَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ ٱلْأَجْنَبِيَّةِ، مِنَ ٱلْغَرِيبَةِ ٱلْمَلِقَةِ بِكَلَامِهَا.
verses.kjv: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger [which] flattereth with her words.
verses.web: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي مِنْ كُوَّةِ بَيْتِي، مِنْ وَرَاءِ شُبَّاكِي تَطَلَّعْتُ،
verses.kjv: ¶ For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
verses.web: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

verses.ar: فَرَأَيْتُ بَيْنَ ٱلْجُهَّالِ، لَاحَظْتُ بَيْنَ ٱلْبَنِينَ غُلَامًا عَدِيمَ ٱلْفَهْمِ،
verses.kjv: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
verses.web: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

verses.ar: عَابِرًا فِي ٱلشَّارِعِ عِنْدَ زَاوِيَتِهَا، وَصَاعِدًا فِي طَرِيقِ بَيْتِهَا.
verses.kjv: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
verses.web: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

verses.ar: فِي ٱلْعِشَاءِ، فِي مَسَاءِ ٱلْيَوْمِ، فِي حَدَقَةِ ٱللَّيْلِ وَٱلظَّلَامِ.
verses.kjv: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
verses.web: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا بِٱمْرَأَةٍ ٱسْتَقْبَلَتْهُ فِي زِيِّ زَانِيَةٍ، وَخَبِيثَةِ ٱلْقَلْبِ.
verses.kjv: And, behold, there met him a woman [with] the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
verses.web: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

verses.ar: صَخَّابَةٌ هِيَ وَجَامِحَةٌ. فِي بَيْتِهَا لَا تَسْتَقِرُّ قَدَمَاهَا.
verses.kjv: (She [is] loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
verses.web: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

verses.ar: تَارَةً فِي ٱلْخَارِجِ، وَأُخْرَى فِي ٱلشَّوَارِعِ، وَعِنْدَ كُلِّ زَاوِيَةٍ تَكْمُنُ.
verses.kjv: Now [is she] without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)
verses.web: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.

verses.ar: فَأَمْسَكَتْهُ وَقَبَّلَتْهُ. أَوْقَحَتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ لَهُ:
verses.kjv: So she caught him, and kissed him, [and] with an impudent face said unto him,
verses.web: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

verses.ar: «عَلَيَّ ذَبَائِحُ ٱلسَّلَامَةِ. ٱلْيَوْمَ أَوْفَيْتُ نُذُورِي.
verses.kjv: [I have] peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
verses.web: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

verses.ar: فَلِذَلِكَ خَرَجْتُ لِلِقَائِكَ، لِأَطْلُبَ وَجْهَكَ حَتَّى أَجِدَكَ.
verses.kjv: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
verses.web: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

verses.ar: بِٱلدِّيبَاجِ فَرَشْتُ سَرِيرِي، بِمُوَشَّى كَتَّانٍ مِنْ مِصْرَ.
verses.kjv: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved [works], with fine linen of Egypt.
verses.web: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

verses.ar: عَطَّرْتُ فِرَاشِي بِمُرٍّ وَعُودٍ وَقِرْفَةٍ.
verses.kjv: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.web: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

verses.ar: هَلُمَّ نَرْتَوِ وُدًّا إِلَى ٱلصَّبَاحِ. نَتَلَذَّذُ بِٱلْحُبِّ.
verses.kjv: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
verses.web: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّجُلَ لَيْسَ فِي ٱلْبَيْتِ. ذَهَبَ فِي طَرِيقٍ بَعِيدَةٍ.
verses.kjv: For the goodman [is] not at home, he is gone a long journey:
verses.web: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

verses.ar: أَخَذَ صُرَّةَ ٱلْفِضَّةِ بِيَدِهِ. يَوْمَ ٱلْهِلَالِ يَأْتِي إِلَى بَيْتِهِ».
verses.kjv: He hath taken a bag of money with him, [and] will come home at the day appointed.
verses.web: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

verses.ar: أَغْوَتْهُ بِكَثْرَةِ فُنُونِهَا، بِمَلْثِ شَفَتَيْهَا طَوَّحَتْهُ.
verses.kjv: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
verses.web: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

verses.ar: ذَهَبَ وَرَاءَهَا لِوَقْتِهِ، كَثَوْرٍ يَذْهَبُ إِلَى ٱلذَّبْحِ، أَوْ كَٱلْغَبِيِّ إِلَى قَيْدِ ٱلْقِصَاصِ،
verses.kjv: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
verses.web: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

verses.ar: حَتَّى يَشُقَّ سَهْمٌ كَبِدَهُ. كَطَيْرٍ يُسْرِعُ إِلَى ٱلْفَخِّ وَلَا يَدْرِي أَنَّهُ لِنَفْسِهِ.
verses.kjv: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it [is] for his life.
verses.web: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

verses.ar: وَٱلْآنَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْأَبْنَاءُ ٱسْمَعُوا لِي وَأَصْغُوا لِكَلِمَاتِ فَمِي:
verses.kjv: ¶ Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
verses.web: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

verses.ar: لَا يَمِلْ قَلْبُكَ إِلَى طُرُقِهَا، وَلَا تَشْرُدْ فِي مَسَالِكِهَا.
verses.kjv: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
verses.web: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهَا طَرَحَتْ كَثِيرِينَ جَرْحَى، وَكُلُّ قَتْلَاهَا أَقْوِيَاءُ.
verses.kjv: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong [men] have been slain by her.
verses.web: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

verses.ar: طُرُقُ ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ بَيْتُهَا، هَابِطَةٌ إِلَى خُدُورِ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.kjv: Her house [is] the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
verses.web: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
